description:
I’m Aishwarya, an engineering admission counsellor who believes good guidance starts with listening to the student.
I help students explore the right college and branch options in Maharashtra using clear cutoff analysis.
I also guide them through CAP rounds and option filling in a step-by-step, stress-free way.
My approach is straightforward, honest, and focused on long-term academic fit.
I aim to help students make decisions they won’t regret later.
